input.question: Who was Anna Palaiologina married to?

documents.text: VIII Palaiologos . [ 1 ] She married the despot of Epirus , John II Orsini , in c. 1323 . Together the couple had a son , Nikephoros , and a daughter , Thomais . [ 2 ] She poisoned her husband in 1337 , and assumed the regency over her underage son , only for Epirus to be invaded and annexed by the Byzantines in 1338 .
